title: SpongeBob Levitating
blurb: A mystical hum, and the sponge simply leaves. The levitating SpongeBob meme treats ascension as a coping strategy, departing your own body rather than continuing to participate in whatever is happening, and this audio is its soundtrack. It plays sincerely and sarcastically at once, which very few sounds manage. Use it for transcendence achieved through snacks, for floating out of an awkward conversation, or for rising above drama both spiritually and, in the edit, literally. When the situation calls for a formal departure from physics, press this.
origin: From the levitating SpongeBob meme, the sound of ascension.
